# Lab 7.6: Data Transfer Service: Database Connectors

## What We Are Going to Do
Set up an incremental transfer from a MySQL database, so only new and changed rows are copied on each run.

## Steps

1. **Prepare a source.** Use the Cloud SQL MySQL instance from Lab 3.8, or recreate it with the same commands. Add a column that changes on every update:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql connect lab-mysql --user=root &lt;&lt;'EOF'
USE shop;
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Create the transfer.** **Pipelines and connections → Create → Load data → MySQL**:
   - **Destination dataset**: `lab07`
   - **Host, port, database, user, password**: from your instance
   - **Network attachment**: needed for private IP sources
   - **Objects**: `shop.customers`
   - **Ingestion type**: **Incremental**, **Watermark column**: `updated_at`, **Primary key**: `id`

3. **[Console] Run it and change the source.** Click **Run transfer now**. Then:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql connect lab-mysql --user=root &lt;&lt;'EOF'
UPDATE shop.customers SET city='Ahmedabad' WHERE id=1;
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Run the transfer again. Only the changed row is read.

4. **[CLI] Check the run logs.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq ls --transfer_run --run_attempt=LATEST &lt;TRANSFER_CONFIG_NAME&gt;
bq show --transfer_log &lt;TRANSFER_RUN_NAME&gt;</span>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Full transfer | Copies the whole table every run |
| Incremental | Only rows with a newer watermark |
| Primary key | Used to merge changed rows |
| Pricing | Billed by slot usage of the transfer |
